about: The Mule's sounds (C4, docs/haul-and-ferry.md section 4): the six-wheeled hauler a Prospector drives standing at two levers. Its voice is the Prospector's (its driver), over the helmet comm like the Prospector's own lines. Ids match the game's sound names (sfx/<name>_<n>): vmule = reports in (a pilot climbs on), muledeath = the driver's cry as the Mule is wrecked (the blast plays with it), mulemove = the Mule's engine as it pulls away (at most every 2 s, in your ear), muleengine = the slow diesel-and-gear drive loop while it rolls, mulegear = a lever thrown into gear (it starts or stops), mulefill = a load tipped into the hopper. Takes are made into unreal/server/build/mule/takes and copied to unreal/Resources/Sounds/sfx/ by Tools/AudioGen/mule_pick.py; checked offline, never played aloud.

entries.text: [crisp, over a helmet radio] Mule's hitched. Let's haul.
[dry, unhurried] Levers in hand. She's slow, but she carries.
[matter-of-fact] On the perch. Point me at the Citadel.
[quick, a little sardonic] Hopper's waiting. Fill her up.
